_comment: Linux (Debian) patch policy for the port flow (fieldkit build-harness start firefox). Derived 2026-10-14 from the Windows machine's config/patch_policy.json: same groups, same order, Linux statuses. The Windows file disabled 01.MEDIA and excluded the GTK, socket and font patches because they are Linux code; here they are the point. Every status carries its reason; change the reason when you change the status.
_fuzz_note: patch --fuzz=3 as on Windows (recreate_success.sh lineage). The replay proof applies with --fuzz=0 and is the stricter judge of the exported set.

01.MEDIA.reason: VA-API / VDPAU / PulseAudio: the Linux media group. Disabled on Windows (DXVA2/WASAPI), it is the reason this build exists on Linux: hardware H.264 only, the 6-layer codec gate (GOLDEN_RULES).

02.GPU.reason: Gecko's graphics blocklist patches, cross-platform; on Linux widget/gtk/GfxInfo.cpp is included (Windows excluded it).

03.NETWORKING.reason: C++ patches in netwerk/. nsSocketTransport2.cpp was excluded on Windows; on Linux it is applied and must be verified against 158 (first port).

04.PERFORMANCE.reason: Expected platform-neutral (Windows verified nothing assumes a Linux scheduler; here the scheduler IS Linux).

05.PREFS.reason: Baked-in prefs. NEW_FILES carries a mozconfig that is NOT used: the Linux build uses the repository's mozconfig (clang-21, lld, sccache, Wayland).

08.Look.reason: Locale patches and the browser/branding/gorilla tree. Windows installer assets inside it are inert on Linux; the .deb takes its icon from deb_template.

10.OVERRIDES.reason: NEW_FILES only (user.js); apply.sh never copies user.js into the tree.

11.FONT.SYSTEM.reason: The font system: Microsoft fonts are fetched by scripts/fonts-microsoft.sh and shipped inside the .deb (settled 2026-08-03); browser/fonts/moz.build is included here (Windows excluded it).

12.MOZAMBIQUE.DRILL.reason: RecipeRunner / RemoteSettingsExperimentLoader timer neutralisation, cross-platform JS.

14.EGRESS.LOCKDOWN.reason: No .patch files; documentation or NEW_FILES only.

16.SNAPSHOT.DELTA.2026-08-12.reason: The 2026-08-12 completeness sweep from the LINUX build tree: one patch per changed file. The generated activity-stream bundle stays excluded (generated output, regenerate instead); the dom/media patches Windows excluded are Linux media and are included.

20.SNAPSHOT.DELTA.155.0.1.reason: The 155.0.1 snapshot delta the 157 port started from: bundled uBlock Origin, the AIWindow stub, built-in extensions. Platform-neutral.

21.PORT.FIXES.157.reason: The 157 port's repairs, exported by the harness on Windows: excision creep, a misplaced hunk, a broken override. Cross-platform source.

22.EGRESS.LOCKDOWN.157.reason: Every privacy cut made in source for 157 (telemetry, Remote Settings, Normandy, hidden about: pages). Cross-platform; 80 patches, 57 files touched by more than one patch: a stacked series, apply in order only.
